authority.freeze_rule: After this file enters git history, values may change only for source/correctness defects or an explicitly versioned new benchmark generation; baseline/proposed-method outcomes are not a valid reason.

source_owned.task_contract_rule: Enumerate every DB44/T 2457-2024 landslide grade×warning-state reporting cell whose source-resolved interval fits the frozen geometry horizon for the requested obligation composition. No cadence value is invented or interpolated.

cache_recovery_semantics.reconnect_rule: cached monitoring records remain recoverable after communication restoration

satellite_geometry.rule: Preserve every eligible model-derived opportunity inside each selected public geometry slice; do not selectively hide or delete windows for hardness.

obligation_composition.rationale: cache06 v0.5 requires two existing report streams, four to six obligations and at least three decision stages. Phase is a declared composition stress because the source fixes cadence but not cross-node synchronization.

support_families.definition: all stage-state sequences containing at most one contiguous DOWN run; recovery may occur and service may remain UP before/after
all stage-state sequences containing at most two DOWN runs; a recovered service may fail again
all UP/DOWN stage-state sequences for the declared finite stage set; diagnostic upper-support control

terrestrial_service_process.rationale: finite-state support is used for robust causal feasibility, not as a field outage-frequency claim

terrestrial_opportunities.unit_semantics: normalized opportunity capacity; one SEND_TERR or center-side remote query consumes one unit when they share the same path
terrestrial_opportunities.claim_boundary: not bytes, airtime or field throughput

remote_query_transport.center_placement: uses the same terrestrial opportunity/capacity ledger as data delivery; if the required path is unavailable the request/response may timeout
remote_query_transport.gateway_placement: owner-local read; no remote request is charged and no center return-path delay is inherited

fallback_budget_modes.rule: derive from the maximum per-world minimum backup demand under full current-state knowledge
TIGHT + 1 normalized backup unit, capped at obligation count
enough normalized backup units to cover every obligation

natural_feedback_always_enabled: execution trace visible at its lawful owner
passive telemetry if provided by the source/profile
forbidden_generator_dependencies: handpicked ACK/query delay chosen after observing an evaluated policy
hidden future opportunity encoded into evidence values
selective deletion of source/model-derived communication opportunities
invented source priority or sacrifice weights
